source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"The document authorizes an agent to manage only finances and property when the person cannot make decisions.","B":"The document names an agent to make health care decisions if the person cannot decide or communicate, within applicable law.","C":"The document functions as a DNR order and applies only to resuscitation decisions during cardiopulmonary arrest.","D":"The document transfers all decision-making authority to the agent immediately after signing, even while the person remains capable."}}
source_row.rationale: A durable power of attorney for health care designates a proxy or agent to make health care decisions if the person becomes unable to decide or communicate, subject to the document and applicable state law. Option B is correct. It is distinct from financial authority and DNR orders, and it does not automatically displace a capable person's decisions.
source_row.source_detail: Durable power of attorney for health care section: names a health care proxy/agent to make health care decisions if the person cannot communicate or make decisions; state rules and document scope apply.
